# Page-by-page quality inventory — 23 October 2026

Baseline: main `f963b1365f56e85aa928a9904598bcb0017c7397`; PR originally `c058f298601a769e039fb112b552248dde6599d8`. All 115 published baseline pages returned HTTP 200. Their server-rendered main text matched the checkout. The 404 route is listed separately.

Coverage: page purpose, main text/headings, repeated paragraphs, tool presence, author/source cues, internal destinations, canonical/sitemap/robots checks and mobile/desktop rendering. Deeper editorial review focused on all 20 goal guides, overlapping articles, model methods, original-story attribution and trust pages. This is not an independent replication of every cited study or a verification of every venue facility in person. Word counts are descriptive baseline main-text counts, not quality scores or an AdSense minimum.

After consolidation: 112 published pages, 20 goal guides, 39 blog articles and all 18 venue guides retained. The three retired pages use permanent redirects; their historical content anchors resolve on the destination guides.
